categories.main_business_segments: China Chippacking Technology Co., Ltd. (Qipai Technology) primarily operates in integrated circuit (IC) packaging and testing services. Its product portfolio includes MEMS, Flip Chip (FC), Qipai, CPC, SOP, SOT, LQFP, QFN/DFN, CDFN/CQFN, DIP, TO, PDFN series, serving sectors such as consumer electronics, information communication, smart home, IoT, industrial automation, and automotive electronics. The company also provides wafer testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced IC packaging technologies including 5G MIMO base station GaN microwave RF power amplifier plastic packaging, high-density large matrix lead frame packaging, small-size pin-design packaging solutions, customized packaging structure design, Flip Chip (FC), MEMS packaging, power device packaging for SiC and GaN chips, and copper clip interconnect technology. Production methods emphasize lean manufacturing, quality management systems, and digital factory initiatives integrating MES, APS, EAP, and ERP systems for intelligent production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qipai Technology's primary customers are IC design companies that outsource wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing. End markets include consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, wearables), automotive electronics, IoT devices, industrial control, and communication sectors. The company actively targets leading customers in these fields and expands into emerging applications such as AI, 5G, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Guangdong Province, including Dongguan and Shenzhen. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and serves both domestic and international markets, with a small portion of revenue from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qipai Technology operates in the midstream to downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in IC packaging and testing services. It procures wafers from foundries and provides value-added packaging and testing before delivering finished IC products to chip design companies and ultimately to electronic device manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced packaging technologies such as 3D packaging, system-in-package (SiP), wafer-level packaging (WLP), and power semiconductor packaging for third-generation semiconductors like SiC and GaN. It invests in developing customized packaging solutions, expanding product variety, and improving production efficiency. The firm also emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance quality and reduce costs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through processing fees for IC packaging and testing services, including both customer-supplied and self-procured wafers. The company also generates income from sales of finished packaged chips and other related services. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control of goods to customers, mainly through direct sales to chip design companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qipai Technology is one of the largest domestic IC packaging and testing enterprises in South China, competing with major domestic and international OSAT providers such as JCET, Hua Tian, Tongfu Microelectronics, Amkor, ASE, and others. While it holds a strong position in traditional and some advanced packaging technologies, it faces competition in cutting-edge advanced packaging segments dominated by global leaders like TSMC and Samsung.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 666.6 million, a 20.25% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -102.1 million, showing reduced losses compared to prior years. Total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. The company has experienced steady revenue growth driven by market recovery and increased orders, despite industry cyclicality and pricing pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qipai Technology differentiates itself through proprietary packaging technologies such as CPC, Qipai, and CDFN/CQFN series, advanced GaN and SiC power device packaging, and customized packaging solutions tailored to customer needs. Its strategic focus on lean manufacturing, quality management, and intelligent production systems enhances product reliability and cost efficiency. The company's geographic proximity to major chip design hubs in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area provides logistical advantages and closer customer collaboration.
